gloss: nape hairline; hair at the back of the neck

definitions.gloss: nape hairline; hair at the back of the neck
definitions.explanation: The hairline at the back of the neck, or the hair growing in that area. Important in hairstyling and traditionally considered an attractive feature in Japanese aesthetics.

examples.japanese: {襟足|えりあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すっきり→すっきり：05180_sukkiri⟧{刈|か}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I had my nape neatly trimmed.

examples.japanese: {襟足|えりあし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}りたい→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: The hair at my nape has gotten long, so I want to get a haircut soon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧とき、{襟足|えりあし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{髪型|かみがた}→髪型：14646_kamigata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When wearing a kimono, a hairstyle that shows the nape hairline looks beautiful.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used at hair salons when requesting a haircut. In traditional Japanese aesthetics, a woman's {襟足|えりあし} visible when wearing kimono is considered elegant and attractive. The word combines ⟦{襟|えり}→襟：06487_eri⟧ (collar/neckline) and ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (foot/base).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {襟足|えりあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ (to tidy the nape hairline)
- {襟足|えりあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刈|か}り{上|あ}げる (to trim the nape)
- {襟足|えりあし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ (nape hair grows out)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うなじ→うなじ：08541_unaji⟧: nape of the neck — refers to the skin area itself, not the hair
- ⟦{生|は}え{際|ぎわ}→生え際：19511_haegiwa⟧: hairline — the general term for where hair meets skin
